meta.lit: The 30 brightest were looked up in SIMBAD and NED: all are known only as radio-survey detections (NVSS, SUMSS, GLEAM), none has a redshift, and one lies near an object listed as a BL Lac candidate. The list has not yet been compared with published samples of distant radio galaxy candidates, nor with pulsar catalogues or VLASS (the CDS services were down).
